title: PERK: Long-Context Reasoning as Test-Time Learning
abstract: arXiv:2507.06415v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Long-context reasoning requires accurately identifying relevant information in extensive, noisy input contexts. In this work, we propose PERK (Parameter Efficient Reasoning over Knowledge), a scalable approach for learning to encode long contexts using gradient updates at test time. Specifically, PERK employs two nested optimization loops in a meta-training phase. The inner loop rapidly encodes contexts into a low-rank adapter (LoRA) that serves as a parameter-efficient memory module for the base model. Concurrently, the outer loop learns to use the updated adapter to accurately recall and reason over relevant information from the encoded long context. Our evaluations on several long-context reasoning tasks show that PERK significantly outperforms the standard long-context finetuning, achieving average absolute performance gains of up to 20% for Qwen-2.5 (0.5B & 7B) on synthetic and real-world long-context reasoning. translated_title: PERK：将长上下文推理作为测试时学习
translated_abstract: 长上下文推理需要在庞大且含噪的输入上下文中准确识别相关信息。在这项工作中，我们提出了PERK（Parameter Efficient Reasoning over Knowledge，基于知识的高效参数推理），这是一种可扩展的方法，通过测试时的梯度更新来学习编码长上下文。具体而言，PERK在元训练阶段采用两个嵌套的优化循环：内循环快速将上下文编码到低秩适配器（LoRA）中，该适配器作为基础模型的参数高效记忆模块；与此同时，外循环学习利用更新后的适配器，从已编码的长上下文中准确回忆并推理相关信息。我们在多个长上下文推理任务上的评估表明，PERK显著优于标准的长上下文微调方法，在合成与真实世界的长上下文推理任务上，为Qwen-2.5（0.5B和7B）模型带来了高达20%的平均绝对性能提升。PERK还保持了……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: PERK通过元训练的内外双循环优化，在测试时利用梯度更新将长上下文编码进LoRA记忆模块，使Qwen-2.5模型在长上下文推理任务上相比标准微调最高获得20%的绝对性能提升。
en_tdlr: PERK employs nested meta-training loops to encode long contexts into a LoRA memory module via test-time gradient updates, achieving up to 20% absolute performance gains over standard long-context finetuning on Qwen-2.5 models.
